name: Agent token
description: git, gh and agent-commit act as the agent GitHub App, with short-lived tokens from token-broker

version.description: token-broker release of the client scripts, e.g. 0.6.0. Empty installs the pinned release, checked against its reviewed sha256; any other is checked only against that release's checksums.txt.

postCreateCommand: git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.checkStat minimal || true
